title: Police Rescue 15-Year-Old Girl From Her HIGHLY Abusive Father
description:
On September 11th, 2022. A 15-year-old called the police on her father after he had choked her, pulled her hair and nearly k*lled her after he refused to let her leave the car. He then gave his child to a family friend the next day. When police confronted the man, he kept trying to deny it even though he admitted it to the family friend. The girl was severely traumatized and was taken to the hospital.
